answer: Each identity locks one opal shard that must emit a pulse inside a 90-second gale window each epoch, drawn from its hash. The k-th identity an operator runs posts a bond of 50 times k: ten fakes lock 2,750, a hundred lock 252,500, and a missed pulse burns the bond. Windows are drawn independently, so many shards mean overlapping windows, and cost cannot be pooled across clones.
